## Problem Statement (المشكلة)

Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe it clearly.

## Proposed Solution (الحل المقترح)

Describe the solution you would like. For a new effect, describe the interaction, the trigger (hover, focus, click, scroll), and the category it would fit in (buttons, text effects, loaders, cards, backgrounds, or inputs).

## Alternatives Considered (البدائل المدروسة)

Describe any alternative solutions or existing effects you have considered.

## Additional Context (سياق إضافي)

Add any other context, links, or mockups here.
